name: Annual Copenhagen Film Festival 2021
description:
🎉 Welcome to the 5th edition of the Annual Copenhagen Film Festival! 🎉

🎬 The two-day festival, as every year, aims at showcasing indie and short films and providing a platform from up and coming filmmakers from around the world.

🎞️ In this edition, the ACFF team is excited to present a wide selection of 26 films, from well-crafted animation, to surreal dramas, light documentaries and odd comedies; films that can make you reflect, feel and connect. 

- Doors open at 18:00 on both days, admission free
- The festival will operate on a first come first serve basis
- All films will be screened in English or with English subtitles.

More information coming soon!

Save the date: November 5-6 🤩
